title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was used to create non-consensual sexual imagery of a real person without her knowledge or agreement. The person who deployed the system obtained the victim's photographs from her private social media account and used an AI tool to generate obscene morphed images, then distributed them across multiple platforms under false identities to conceal his involvement.

This is a case of a technology deployed outside any legitimate use case, applied deliberately to harm. The system itself had no mechanism to prevent creation of non-consensual intimate imagery. It is not established whether the AI provider knew their system would be used this way or built safeguards against such misuse.

What would have caught this: either the AI system refusing to generate non-consensual sexual content, or the social media platforms detecting and removing the fake accounts and content faster. The attacker's deliberate use of multiple identities and platforms shows how difficult detection becomes when bad actors coordinate their distribution.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and spreading sexually explicit artificial intelligence-generated images of a college acquaintance. The suspect obtained photographs from the woman's private social media account and used AI technology to create obscene morphed images. He then circulated the fake content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using several Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

Police began investigating after the 22-year-old victim reported the crime to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi. She had received messages from anonymous accounts informing her that her manipulated images were being shared on Discord servers, along with threatening messages intended to humiliate her. Through digital analysis of the fake profiles, email accounts, and social media activity, investigators identified and arrested Bansal. During questioning, he admitted knowing the victim from college and revealed that personal resentment had motivated his actions. Police recovered his mobile phone, SIM cards, and other digital evidence as the investigation continues.
